item.title: [paper] Fractal Neural Synthesis: Constant-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation via Complex Quadratic Boundary Dynamics
item.description: Conventional neural networks store synaptic parameters as explicit tensors whose persistent Flash footprint scales linearly (O(W)) with parameter count, constraining resource-limited edge microcontrollers.

item.title: [paper] Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth
item.description: A pretrained diffusion transformer is distilled into a weight-shared looped student that supports variable loop counts at inference and uses depth-wise ODE solvers and loop guidance to match teacher quality with fewer parameters and less compute.

item.title: [paper] Separating Measurement Failures from Defence Failures in Split Language-Model Privacy
item.description: Split-training privacy evaluations fail through distinct mechanisms.

item.title: [paper] ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
item.description: An online benchmark evaluates in-context learning across computer-use and robot-use agent tasks, revealing large gaps between digital and physical performance and between recognizing rules and acting on them.

item.title: [repo] CybeDefend/cybedefend
item.description: Open-source self-hosted application security platform that performs full security audits and proves vulnerabilities with automated exploit tests.

item.title: [repo] DeadInternetStudios/100x-engineer-skill
item.description: 100x-engineer-skill is an open-source coding assistant skill that breaks down prompts and formally verifies blocks of code to produce production-ready software.

item.title: [repo] biTQ-m/awesome-antigravity-plugins
item.description: Curated directory of plugins, desktop HUDs, CLI statuslines, and marketplace extensions for Google Antigravity developer tools.

item.title: [paper] OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering
item.description: We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing.

item.title: [paper] Small Learned Projections for Semantic-Reversal-Aware Retrieval with Spectral Acceleration: A Four-Domain Empirical Study
item.description: Dense-embedding retrievers can fail adversarially: when a query is answered by a document A and reversed by a near-copy B that differs from A by a small meaning-changing edit (a "trap"), raw cosine over E5-Large-v2 places B in the top-10 for 82-100% of queries at a pool of…

item.title: [paper] Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load: Synchronization, Rule Execution and Misfires on the Background
item.description: A method separates a language model's quality decline under controlled load into synchronization, rule execution, and misfires, then derives load-dependent laws that characterize each model.

item.title: [paper] Mega-MMDF and DeepfakeBench-MM: Benchmarking Multimodal Deepfake Detection Across Diverse Forgery Pipelines
item.description: A large audio-visual deepfake benchmark and standardized evaluation suite show that diverse composite-forgery training improves detection performance but does not reliably generalize to constituent manipulations, while modality masking and temporal misalignment increase…

item.title: [repo] Intellindust-AI-Lab/LoopDVR
item.description: Looped Transformer architecture for efficient dense visual recognition that achieves high parameter efficiency in object detection and instance segmentation.

item.title: [paper] Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
item.description: Separating dynamics prediction from visual rendering using 3D point dynamics as an intermediate representation improves object motion accuracy in robotic video world models without sacrificing image quality.

item.description: World model by Google DeepMind unlocking unprecedented realism in real-time simulation.

item.description: A reinforcement learning framework, RECAP, optimizes context compaction by aligning compressed-context behavior with original-history behavior, improving long-horizon agent performance.

item.description: Carry is a desktop tool that automatically backs up your ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok chats as local Markdown files for easy searching and cross-platform continuation.

item.title: [news] Models Can Communicate via Inference Servers Despite Being Sandboxed
item.description: Two AI agents running on the same inference server can reliably communicate even when sandboxed from direct messaging.

item.title: [news] PenGPT: A Generative Transformer for Handwriting and Sketches
item.description: Small transformer model that writes handwriting and draws sketches from text prompts or symbol tokens.

item.title: [news] Three LLM inflection points in twelve months
item.description: I gave a keynote at the AI Engineer Code Summit a couple of weeks ago, constructed around the idea that there have been three significant inflection points in the abilities of LLMs and coding agents in the past twelve months. Here's the video of the talk.

item.title: [news] GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
item.description: OpenAI introduces a family of models capable of designing new protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code without specialized biology models.

item.title: [paper] OmniAct: One Policy, One Million Embodiments
item.description: OmniAct is a cross-embodiment robot manipulation policy that conditions on a kinematic graph to produce embodiment-specific behavior across diverse physical structures.

item.title: [paper] PointX: Multi-View Consistent Intrinsics by Querying Surface Points
item.description: PointX is a feed-forward model that predicts multi-view consistent 3D intrinsics per surface point by querying tokens across unposed images.

item.title: [paper] DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
item.description: DiaCap is an audiovisual language model that jointly produces transcripts, timestamps, and speaker visual descriptions for dialogue captioning and diarization.

item.title: [paper] BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles
item.description: BioLoom is a biomedical vision-language model trained on a 52-million-pair dataset structured from scientific articles to improve multi-domain zero-shot classification.

item.title: [paper] CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
item.description: CoT-Proxy is a distillation method that trains long-horizon student policies using teacher actions and reasoning summaries without requiring access to hidden teacher chains-of-thought.

item.title: [paper] One Take, Many Cameras: Audio-Grounded Shot Synthesis for Dialogue Re-Cinematography
item.description: Audio-Grounded Shot Synthesis is a dialogue re-cinematography method that uses view-invariant speech audio and speaker-aware audio gating to generate synchronized multi-camera shots from a single video.

item.title: [paper] Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild
item.description: Lost on Campus is a benchmark evaluating the embodied spatial reasoning of vision-language models in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting.

item.title: [paper] ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
item.description: ROAM-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating embodied active spatial intelligence in indoor environments under robot motion and collision constraints using evidence verification.

item.title: [paper] iWAM: Efficient Action Prediction from World Models without Explicit Future Prediction
item.description: iWAM is an action-prediction method that conditions policies on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation using a bidirectional flow map to reduce inference cost in real-time control.

item.title: [paper] Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action
item.description: Physicl Scenes is a dataset of 6,499 artist-created 3D scenes with detailed geometry, physical materials, and semantic annotations to support visual and embodied learning research.

item.title: [paper] BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation
item.description: BriConstrain is a geometrically constrained decoding method that restricts a pretrained language model's next-token probabilities to generate valid brick assemblies without collisions.

item.title: [paper] A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit
item.description: A fine-tuning method using small gradient edits on specific layers stops small language models from looping and complements weight edits in large models to improve reasoning accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Exploratory Midtraining for Robot Policies
item.description: Beta-Data is an adversarial teleoperation dataset and midtraining approach that builds low-level behavioral coverage to improve robot policy execution and online adaptation.

item.title: [paper] SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report
item.description: SAG-Mem is a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and uses query-time lexical expansion to retrieve complementary facts.

item.title: [paper] MetaFORGE: A Meta-Learning Framework for Harness Optimization in Automated Code Generation for Parallel Computing
item.description: MetaFORGE is a meta-learning framework that iteratively optimizes natural-language skill specifications using execution feedback to improve automated code generation for parallel computing.

item.title: [paper] Read My Lips: Context-aware Lip Reading Using Language and Audio-Visual Models
item.description: Read My Lips is a collaborative method combining a lip reader, a language model, and an audio-visual generative model to reconstruct speech from partially observable audio-visual data.

item.title: [paper] Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions
item.description: Draft calibration for speculative decoding applies standard temperature scaling to the draft distribution to mitigate distribution mismatch and improve acceptance length by up to 10 percent.

item.title: [paper] Temporal Conditioning for Human Behavioral Cloning in Chess
item.description: Temporal conditioning introduces a time-aware transformer for chess behavioral cloning that encodes player clock states to improve move-quality predictions and performance under time pressure.

item.title: [paper] Reinforcement Learning Can Be Recovered From Its Own Rollouts
item.description: Reinforcement learning maximum likelihood updates on archived model rollouts can recover the performance of online reinforcement learning without discarding computed knowledge.

item.title: [paper] GREMLIN: Generating Random Environments for Meta-Learning with Interacting Networks
item.description: GREMLIN generates random neural environments for meta-learning reinforcement learning rules to supply useful experience and improve agent learning.

item.title: [paper] Delegent: A Multi-Agent Harness That Reduces Cost without Sacrificing Performance
item.description: Delegent is a multi-agent harness that delegates easy subtasks to small language models to reduce the inference cost of frontier models without sacrificing performance.

item.title: [paper] EventDiffusion: Learning Native Event Stream Distribution from Videos
item.description: EventDiffusion is a hierarchical generative framework that directly learns the conditional distribution of native asynchronous event streams from real video recordings.

item.title: [paper] AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
item.description: AIChipBench evaluates LLM coding agents on automated AI accelerator design, showing that state-specific debugging feedback improves hardware synthesis success.

item.title: [paper] The Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) Dataset
item.description: The Radar-based Activities of Daily Living dataset provides over eight hours of annotated radar recordings across five locations to support privacy-preserving activity recognition research.

item.title: [paper] Uncertainty-Aware Candidate Generation for Entity Linking in Cyber Threat Intelligence
item.description: Uncertainty-aware entity linking preserves upstream ambiguity signals from named entity recognition using Monte Carlo dropout and fuzzy entropy to improve retrieval recall in cyber threat intelligence.

item.title: [paper] Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation
item.description: Shifter Quantization reconstructs native-width integer operands using shifted shared bits to improve low-bit LLM quantization quality and accelerate inference throughput.

item.title: [paper] FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics
item.description: FOL-Proof is a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated first-order logic translations against independent linguistic interpretations to improve reasoning accuracy.

item.title: [paper] On the Creation of Object-Centric Event Logs from Patient Journeys
item.description: An approach for generating object-centric event logs from patient journeys is presented to help investigate care delivery and health system design using process mining techniques.

item.title: [paper] The Reliability Function of Error-Correcting Output Codes with Noisy Binary Classifiers
item.description: A theoretical study on error-correcting output coding with noisy binary classifiers derives upper and lower bounds for the excess error rate to determine the reliability function.

item.title: [paper] Auditing the Judge: Human-Derived Bias Discovery, Quantification, and Mitigation in LLM Judges
item.description: HUB-J is an integrated framework that uses human-LLM disagreement and agreement cases to automatically detect, quantify, and mitigate systematic biases in LLM judges.

item.title: [paper] U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning
item.description: A pessimistic ratio estimator addresses the challenge of adaptive group size selection in group relative policy optimization, reducing mean squared error and improving policy training.

item.title: [paper] Understanding Clipping In Zeroth-Order Optimization
item.description: A systematic analysis of per-sample clipping in zeroth-order optimization reveals that it improves test accuracy and robustness by down-weighting hard-to-fit training examples.

item.title: [paper] SUPRA: Synthesizing Amyloid PET from MRI and Plasma Biomarkers with an Explicit Regional SUVR Prior
item.description: SUPRA is a method for synthesizing brain amyloid PET images from structural MRI and plasma biomarkers by combining an explicit regional SUVR prior with a 3D network.

item.title: [paper] ClusterVAD: Threshold-Free Unsupervised Voice Activity Detection with Pre-Trained Neural Representations
item.description: ClusterVAD is an unsupervised voice activity detection method built on frozen speech foundation models that clusters representations to perform threshold-free detection.

item.title: [paper] Local Indices Are Not Enough: Synchrony and Global Information in Bandit Algorithms
item.description: An investigation into bandit algorithms proves that asynchronous local index algorithms cannot achieve logarithmic regret, demonstrating that global information and synchrony are essential for optimality.

item.title: [paper] Worth the Wait? How Response Time and Streaming Shape Judgments of Generative AI Answers and Chatbot Engagement
item.description: Empirical analyses show that streaming chatbot answers progressively increases user preference votes compared to displaying complete stored answers instantly.

item.title: [paper] Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs
item.description: Latent-space LoRA merging method combines hypernetwork-generated LoRAs in the intermediate latent space, improving performance over weight-space and factor-space baselines while maintaining a single fixed-rank adapter.

item.title: [paper] When Is Product Decoding of ECOC MAP-Consistent? Pair Structure and the n-vs-Rest Codes
item.description: Theorem and Lean 4 machine-checked proofs establish that the product decoder of Error-Correcting Output Codes is MAP-consistent if and only if the code is a union of n-vs-Rest codes.

item.title: [paper] Spectrify: Framework for Hyperspectral Image Generation Using Computer Graphics
item.description: Spectrify framework converts 3D scene datasets into hyperspectral images using physically based optical models and a material-labeled reflectance spectra library to improve training data for low-level computer vision.

item.title: [paper] Linear Probes Can Guide: Training-Free Control of Representation Generators
item.description: LiSM framework uses linear probes in the semantic mean-space of vision foundation models to provide training-free, lightweight control for representation-space generative models across global and local tasks.

item.title: [paper] Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
item.description: Fixed-ranking benchmark evaluates eight heterogeneous uncertainty quantification signals for LLM-based recommenders, showing that ranking-aligned Top10Mass provides strong scalar Error@10 detection.

item.title: [paper] Hybrid AI for AI-Native RAN Control: A Functional Perspective
item.description: Technique-agnostic taxonomy organizes AI-native radio access network control around four functional capabilities to evaluate hybrid AI systems, decision-making processes, and reproducible simulation platforms.

item.title: [paper] SHARPnP: Self-Supervised and Plug-and-Play Hyperspectral Super-Resolution from Real Noisy Unaligned Camera Measurements
item.description: SHARPnP framework combines joint registration and plug-and-play fusion for reference-free, RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution from noisy and unaligned camera measurements.

item.title: [paper] Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?
item.description: Method using Claude LLMs edits raw network weights as text to perform tool-free 4-bit quantization repair, recovering most of the accuracy lost during standard round-to-nearest quantization.

item.title: [paper] SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment
item.description: SALSA generative framework samples adversarial suffixes from learned distributions to enable fast and efficient LLM safety vulnerability assessments and black-box jailbreak attacks.

item.title: [paper] Score-Based Diffusion for Hypergraph Signals in the t-Spectral Domain
item.description: Score-based generative model operates in the t-spectral domain of hypergraph signal processing to generate and denoise signals on fixed hypergraphs and recover missing nodes.

item.title: [paper] Best Arm Identification with Unknown Post-Action Context Distribution
item.description: A Track-and-Stop algorithm optimizes best arm identification with unknown post-action context distributions by matching an instance-dependent sample complexity lower bound.

item.title: [paper] PAC-style Bounds on the Conditional Validity of Conformal Predictors
item.description: PAC-type probabilistic lower bounds quantify the input-conditional coverage of conformal predictors without requiring assumptions on the underlying data distribution.

item.title: [paper] RecordRoute: Auditing Agent Failures with Localization-Guided Diagnosis
item.description: RecordRoute couples comparative localization with local diagnosis to audit agent execution failures by ranking records through trajectory comparisons.

item.title: [paper] GRAPE-Bench: When Vision Degrades, Does Video Reasoning Hold?
item.description: GRAPE-Bench jointly evaluates video reasoning models across various visual degradation conditions and question difficulties using synthetic and real-world footage.

item.title: [paper] E-MAPS: Event-Based Promptable Video Segmentation with Memory-as-Prompt
item.description: E-MAPS transfers a pretrained promptable segmenter to event streams using Event-to-Token alignment and Memory-Aware Prompting for video object segmentation.

item.title: [paper] RePix-VFI: Re-rendering Observed Pixels for Video Frame Interpolation with Generative Priors from One-Step Diffusion
item.description: RePix-VFI is a multi-frame video frame interpolation framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with the re-rendering of observed keyframe pixels.

item.title: [paper] Training Lightweight Gaze Models without Target Gaze Annotation: What Makes a Good Teacher?
item.description: Model-generated labels from specific teachers can train lightweight gaze target estimation models that match the accuracy of models trained on human annotations.

item.title: [paper] RFW-W: Scaling Physical Asset Universes for Generative Embodied Simulation
item.description: RFW-W provides a physical asset universe connecting rigid, articulated, and deformable assets to task-conditioned scene composition for embodied simulation.

item.title: [paper] Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study
item.description: Access to clinical evidence and full trajectory information significantly improves the reliability of large language model judges in detecting unsafe clinical actions.

item.title: [paper] MESSI: Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration for Physics-Based Character Control
item.description: MESSI uses shared adaptation and a context-conditioned low-rank adapter to enable smooth physics-based character transitions between multiple soccer skills.

item.title: [paper] Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
item.description: A new benchmark shows that many robot manipulation policies perform worse when mirrors are present, often because they confuse reflections with real objects rather than simply colliding with the mirror.

item.title: [paper] Train What You Run: Probabilistic Convolutions for Learning Token Compaction in State Space Models
item.description: ProbConv is a differentiable operator for state space models that computes expected convolutions under token compaction, improving performance as more tokens are removed across image, vision-language, and video tasks.

item.title: [paper] Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory
item.description: Leto is a utility-centric memory system for large language model agents that uses an index and a response-based utility loop to anticipate and supply required future context.

item.title: [paper] LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training
item.description: LEGOSpec is a composable framework for speculative draft design that isolates component effects and introduces DFlux, a balanced draft model that improves acceptance length across various workloads.

item.title: [paper] One, No One and One Hundred Thousand CTs: Testing Anatomical Control in Text-to-CT Generation
item.description: CtrlCT is an evaluation toolkit that tests the credibility and anatomical control of text-to-CT generators by analyzing how report edits systematically change generated computed tomography scans.

item.title: [paper] First-Hit Photoconsistency for Neural Surface Reconstruction
item.description: A neural surface reconstruction method uses multi-view patch photoconsistency with geometry-based visibility and sphere tracing to achieve accurate geometry without volumetric rendering or parametric appearance models.

item.title: [paper] Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration
item.description: An exploratory computational study uses small language models to examine second-language acquisition, finding that elastic weight consolidation slightly reduces parameter drift during sequential training.

item.title: [paper] PAVE: Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning for the Blind and Low-Vision Users
item.description: PAVE is a visual egocentric learning framework for blind and low-vision users that combines structured answer-policy fine-tuning, query routing, and filter-GRPO alignment to improve assistive response quality.

item.title: [paper] Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration
item.description: Radev is a decision-native 3D medical multimodal model that combines anatomy-guided visual compression, single-pass candidate prediction, and counterfactual calibration to improve clinical decision-making from CT scans.

item.title: [paper] On Potentiality and Actuality Of Foundation Models
item.description: A study on foundation models proposes the potentiality principle, showing that task adaptation can be achieved largely through a constant, input-independent shift vector per layer.

item.title: [paper] AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training
item.description: AVQ-Attention-2 is an adaptive vector-quantized attention mechanism that uses exact local blocks and cluster means to achieve linear-cost training and efficient inference without requiring fine-tuning.

item.title: [paper] CAPER: PartGround and PlanRefine for Reliable Manual-Guided Robotic Assembly Planning
item.description: CAPER is a manual-guided robotic assembly framework that uses vision-language models to generate reliable assembly procedures with improved inventory consistency and part reliability.

item.title: [paper] When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures
item.description: Verified failure-driven repair fine-tunes vision-language models on verified failure cases to improve spatial reasoning accuracy while revealing vulnerabilities in negation tasks.

item.title: [paper] NEST: Uncovering and Nesting Unknown Objects in Open-World Object Detection
item.description: NEST is an open-world object detector that uses a class-agnostic ranker and taxonomic reasoning to uncover and categorize unknown objects.

item.title: [paper] File Size as a Potential Dataset Bias in Audio-Visual Deepfake Data
item.description: An analysis of audio-visual deepfake datasets reveals that simple file-level properties like file size and duration can create significant dataset biases.

item.title: [paper] Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval
item.description: TARA-inspired techniques adapt multimodal embedding models for time-sensitive video retrieval by combining keeping loss, pair loss, and middle-layer LoRA training.

item.title: [paper] FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues
item.description: FocusAnchor is a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups and a depth foundation prior to achieve zero-shot metric depth estimation across varied cameras.

item.title: [paper] Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention
item.description: Targeted training interventions such as sentence repetition and loss reweighting elicit the underutilized associative recall capacity of linear attention models.

item.title: [paper] VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans
item.description: VidForce is an approach that estimates interaction trajectories and force profiles from third-person RGB videos using learned physical prototypes as priors.

item.title: [paper] Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
item.description: DriveAnswer is a benchmark of over 20,000 questions designed to evaluate whether vision-language models can determine if visual evidence is sufficient for autonomous driving tasks.

item.title: [paper] Polynomial-Time Learning of Random Automata from One Label per Word
item.description: A polynomial-time algorithm learns random binary deterministic finite automata from single-bit word labels by comparing label moments at consecutive history lengths.

item.title: [paper] Attestation is All You Need: Toward a Zero-Trust Architecture for HPC AI Agents
item.description: A runtime defense system called AEGIS uses behavioral attestation and system-call interception to detect compromised AI agents in high-performance computing environments and trigger cluster-level containment.

item.title: [paper] "I Do Intend to Deliver": Will LLMs Run a Marketplace Advance-Fee Scam?
item.description: A benchmark study demonstrates that off-the-shelf large language models can successfully automate advance-fee scam conversations to extract payments from users.

item.title: [paper] LoomKV: Lossless KV Cache Compression from GPU Memory to SSD for LLM Serving
item.description: A lossless KV cache compression method called LoomKV accelerates large language model serving and reduces memory usage by storing compressed key-value states in GPU memory and SSD tiers.

item.title: [paper] FedTumor-IoMT: Federated Learning-Aided Brain Tumor Diagnosis on Resource-Constrained Edge IoMT Devices
item.description: A multitask federated learning framework enables privacy-preserving brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge devices using selective encoder freezing.

item.title: [paper] OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding
item.description: A modality-aware framework called OmniHarness-RSI improves omnimodal understanding by factorizing agent evolution into specific perception and collaboration dimensions and recursively refining agent harnesses.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Expected Value: PPO with Distributional Critics for Systematic Conservation Planning
item.description: A reinforcement learning framework combines proximal policy optimization with an implicit quantile network to improve systematic conservation planning under ecological and climatic uncertainty.

item.title: [paper] Online V-Learning with Adaptive Longitudinal Data
item.description: A statistical theory establishes the consistency and asymptotic normality of online V-learning for estimating optimal dynamic treatment regimes from adaptively collected longitudinal data.

item.title: [paper] ShellBench: What Matters More for AI Agents, Models, or Harness for Everyday Tasks
item.description: A benchmark of 100 day-to-day tasks called ShellBench shows that model choice has a greater impact on AI agent performance than agent harness selection.

item.title: [paper] PHM-ensemble: Scalable and Stable Probabilistic Multiresolution Clustering via Ensemble Density Estimation
item.description: A probabilistic framework called PHM-ensemble performs multiresolution clustering by pooling mixture models from an ensemble of fits to deliver scalable, stable, and interpretable exploratory data analysis.

item.title: [paper] Quantum kernels on breast data: concentration, surrogates, and two ways an advantage gets manufactured
item.description: A benchmark analysis of quantum kernels on breast data finds that reported quantum advantages often stem from comparator selection, data leakage, or evaluation choices rather than inherent quantum superiority.

item.title: [paper] ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection
item.description: ProX-MAD is a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable proxies for unified few-shot medical anomaly detection across diverse datasets.

item.title: [paper] Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition
item.description: An evaluation of vision-language models reveals that they struggle to predict their own visual weaknesses in advance, though response probabilities can signal these errors during generation.

item.title: [paper] One Style Fits All? Cultural Values Embedded in Conversational AI via a People-Pleasing Lens
item.description: A study on conversational AI interaction styles shows that supportive chatbots consistently improve user satisfaction and trust across different cultural contexts.

item.title: [paper] Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
item.description: Lembas is a token allocation framework for video retrieval-augmented generation that optimizes frame and subtitle token budgets to improve long-video understanding efficiency and accuracy.

item.title: [paper] HARI4D: Hand-Articulation Aware 4D Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction
item.description: HARI4D is a hand-articulation-aware method for reconstructing spatially and temporally consistent 4D human-object interactions from monocular RGB video.

item.title: [paper] Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification
item.description: A generative verification method stops text decoding early to efficiently check assistant reports for unsupported claims without requiring full error localization generation.

item.title: [paper] Theory-Informed Quantum Error Mitigation for Shor Order Finding with Fourier Neural Operators
item.description: A theory-informed quantum error mitigation method uses Fourier neural operators to recover correct order estimates from noisy circuit measurements in Shor order finding.

item.title: [paper] InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning
item.description: InstructReplay is a fine-tuning method that preserves a language model's general abilities by having it replay its own initial answers to general instructions during training.

item.title: [paper] SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search
item.description: SOARS is a training-free framework that uses a fast relevance estimation model to improve answer accuracy and reduce latency in deep search agents.

item.title: [paper] IMPACT-Seg: Consistent Anatomical Segmentation and Representation Learning Across CT, CBCT, and MRI
item.description: IMPACT-Seg is an anatomical segmentation framework that uses shared network parameters to maintain consistent segmentation and representation learning across CT, CBCT, and MRI images.

item.title: [paper] Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking
item.description: Motion-Conditioned World Modeling incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions to improve embodied visual tracking performance and cross-environment generalization.

item.title: [paper] Label leakage through file headers: geometry and batch confounds in public mammography datasets, and a pre-training acceptance gate
item.description: Pre-training controls applied to public mammography datasets reveal that non-diagnostic information like image geometry and file headers can yield uninformatively high diagnostic performance.

item.title: [paper] DualSpec: Spectral Reconstruction with Optimized Stereo Cameras
item.description: DualSpec is a stereo acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two external optical filters and a reconstruction network to recover dense spectra from RGB images with reduced error.

item.title: [paper] Shared information governs multi-view planted matching
item.description: Theoretical analysis reveals the exact shared information and bipartition thresholds that govern when shuffled views of identical objects can be successfully matched across multiple views.
